other_conditions: Applicant must be covered under the National Food Security Act (NFSA) or State Food Security Scheme (SFSS)
If no NFSA/SFSS card, family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000 per annum
Applicant must not be a current or former Member of Parliament (MP) or Member of the Legislative Assembly (MLA)
Applicant must not be an Income Tax Payee
Applicant must not be an elected public representative in any Urban Local Body or Panchayati Raj Institution (excluding Ward Member / Councillor)

Applicant must not be employed as a regular or contractual employee in State Government, Government of India, PSU, board, local body or government organization, nor receiving pension after retirement (honorarium workers are exempt)
Applicant must not be an elected/nominated/appointed representative in any Government Department, Undertaking, Board or Organization of Government of India or State Government
Applicant must not be an owner of a 4‑wheeler motor vehicle (except tractors, mini‑trucks, small commercial vehicles and similar light‑goods vehicles)
Applicants receiving financial assistance of ₹1,500 per month (₹18,000 per annum) or more from any State or Central Government scheme are ineligible
benefits_summary: Beneficiaries receive a SUBHADRA ATM‑cum‑debit card and financial support of ₹50,000 over five years (₹10,000 annually), with additional incentives for top digital transaction performers.
documents_required: Application form (collected from Anganwadi Centres, Block Offices, Urban Local Body Offices, Mo Seba Kendras, Common Service Centres, etc.)
Copies of mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
